capabilities: run a pomodoro timer in a draggable, corner-anchoring widget
play a constant ticking sound and a toggleable alarm sound
set the timer by winding the widget or with a button, with automatic reset
place the widget toggle in the ribbon, status bar, or command palette
extras: Includes a section for plugin developers on reusing the widget class in their own plugins, and instructions for building from source with NodeJS.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in pomodoro timer, so users who want timed focus sessions while taking notes need an external app.
summary: Pomodoro timer widget styled after a wind-up kitchen timer, with constant ticking and alarm sounds, plus a stopwatch.
